articles.summary: Gurugram, August 20, 2026 – VinFast India, the Indian subsidiary of global electric vehicle manufacturer VinFast, has signed a Memorandum of Understanding (MOU) with Federal Bank, one of India’s leading private sector banks, to provide tailored inventory financing solutions for its authorised dealer network.
articles.title: VINFAST INDIA PARTNERS WITH FEDERAL BANK TO STRENGTHEN DEALER FINANCING ECOSYSTEM

articles.summary: Jakarta, August 15, 2026 – VinFast and Gowa Motor Group, an established Indonesian automotive group with experience across multiple automotive brands, today announced the signing of a strategic Memorandum of Understanding (MOU) to establish a joint venture that will develop VinFast’s electric vehicle dealership network in Indonesia.
articles.title: VINFAST PARTNERS WITH GOWA MOTOR GROUP TO ESTABLISH A JOINT VENTURE AND EXPAND DEALERSHIP NETWORK IN INDONESIA

articles.title: VINFAST FURTHER EXPANDS AUTHORIZED SERVICE OUTLET NETWORK IN INDONESIA, ENHANCING THE AFTERSALES EXPERIENCE

articles.summary: Patna, August 6, 2026 – VinFast Auto India, a subsidiary of global electric vehicle manufacturer VinFast, has announced the inauguration of its first 3S dealership in Bihar, marking its 60th retail outlet in India.
articles.title: VINFAST INDIA MARKS 60 DEALERSHIPS WITH FIRST 3S OUTLET IN BIHAR

articles.summary: Hanoi, August 11, 2026 – VinFast Auto Ltd. (“VinFast” or the “Company”) announced preliminary domestic Vietnam deliveries of 21,781 electric vehicles (“EVs”) for July 2026, representing an increase of 21% compared to the previous month.
articles.title: VINFAST REPORTS DELIVERIES OF 21,781 ELECTRIC VEHICLES IN JULY 2026 IN VIETNAM
